claim.statement: GitHub's current firewall guide says organization and repository administrators can, subject to organization policy, enable or disable the integrated firewall and recommended allowlist and combine organization and repository custom allowlist rules.

source.title: Customizing or disabling the firewall for GitHub Copilot
source.locator: Configuring the firewall at the organization level; Configuring the firewall at the repository level

limitations: Configuration authority depends on organization-level settings and repository administration; the dossier does not infer who controls a real repository.
The source describes settings, not the effectiveness of custom network controls.
unknowns: The effective firewall state and exact combined allowlist for a particular task are unknown.
Whether another network control replaces the integrated firewall when disabled is unknown.

relationships.note: Customized and disabled policies are alternatives to the documented default state.
